exposure: Cannabis use companions (gender and sexual orientation of companions: sexual minority women, sexual minority men, non-binary individuals, heterosexual women, heterosexual men)
cohort: The participants were 321 cisgender sexual minority women and sexual minority non-binary individuals assigned female at birth who reported using cannabis during at least one wave of a larger study.
finding: Using cannabis with sexual minority women and non-binary individuals was associated with increases in problematic cannabis use six months later among cisgender sexual minority women and sexual minority non-binary individuals.
